notes.title: Shale: Version 0.5
notes.content:
0.5 Update Notes

The Forest
This major update includes the addition of the forest location. The newly designed tile set will mean the player will move around the forest slightly differently to the previous city variety. For all enemies, the player will travel between city and forest until future updates bring more locations. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/67a16966639deb362ab4e4f2d5acfb62bfb0ab6b.png"]
Visual Effects
I've also been working on improving the overall visual style of Shale to have more variety in color and light. Here is a small example of some of the changes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/b70e34e070001cb135fa68082b21ecd1ee312b38.png"]
Other Content Additions
The Level Cap has now been increased to 50.

1 new character, bag, car and weapon tint to unlock.

1 new tape and note to discover.

1 new car model and wheel type to unlock.

1 new character body, head, bag and weapon model to unlock.

3 new music tracks, enemies and bosses to encounter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/e22d2a7c4e49de5a2fc8b498955ac929f2df7346.png"]
Gameplay Changes
First respawn orb now spawns 10 shale.

Second respawn orb now has small hazard that pushes the player away if touched.

Moved battery, can opener, pocket knife and bucket to common loot drop pool.

Added crowbar and bolt cutter to common loot pool.

Rare loot and rare crafted items now colored yellow and play sound effect when looted.
Improvements
Reduced animation glitches across all enemies.

Fixed error when items were added to traders.

Wind audio looping errors across maps caused audio cutting. This has been solved.

Fixed issue where UI scroll lists were missing items.

The last few notes and tapes sometimes were not dropping. This is fixed.

When generating skills, the cost now remains at 50.

Possessed were sometimes not spawning during combat. The issue was the spawning system sometimes miscalculating the spawn location. This is now solved.

Fixed bug when player constantly re-rolled on skill selection and missing cost minimum.

Solved issue where the airdrop thief was spawning notes and tapes physically inside the dropped container.

Fixed issue with consumed spawning in strange locations due to collision errors.



Feel free to jump in, try the update, and let me know what you think! ːsteamhappyːhttps://store.steampowered.com/developer/dystopiainteractive 
https://discord.com/invite/bDb6BvqwN8

notes.title: Shale: Version 0.4
notes.content:
0.4 Update Notes

Skill Points
With this update I've finished off the levelling and skill system. Now once you level up or collect enough Shale (only by pickup), you'll be given a skill point which you can apply at your car. This process requires you to have at least 50 Shale and 1 skill point so you can generate your options and spending 50 Shale each time if you want to roll again. I've also added more options to choose from now including damage resistances, dodge cool-down, crafting XP boost and more. This point system has a maximum of 250 which eventually maxes out all stats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/50f4ed008474b1978485cc744595408627c7e6b0.png

New Loot
This update I've included some rare loot which can be crafted into expensive items that the player can sell. The full list is below but the main 3 items are a Generator, Lighter and Water Filter. You can also see the benefits of crafting and selling these as they'll help with costs for fusing items and generating skill options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/c590b0116d1a87c127b73017baf3d8ad7cbc7c5d.png

Getting Started
I've improved the getting started screen to hopefully give a better introduction for new players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/dd05a750e516df90f26cf0e79082600eec16abc8.png

Additional Notes

Level cap increased to 35
3 new enemies for level 35
2 new tapes to collect
1 new note to collect
New weapon, car, character and backpack tints
New character, backpack, weapon, head, and wheel models to unlock
Junker walk animation improvements
Audio improvements and weapon balancing
Main screen improvements


Feel free to jump in, try the update, and let me know what you think! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Shale: Version 0.22
notes.content:
0.22 Update Notes

NPCs
New NPCs, friendly "Junkers" will now spawn around the map and the starting location. You will be able to trade with some of them. These traders will have 3 items (1 health, 1 junk, 1 weapon or armor) to trade but will also have a chance to drop a rare "Set" item that you can purchase for a low price.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/a791390e734cce45e9f229019f4823f4d8087214.png

Alt-Fire
Every "Barrel" weapon part has an Alt-Fire ammo type. You will now be able to use Explosive, Fire, Oil or Acid. But be careful as particular enemies are totally immune to certain ammo types and damage over time effects do not stack (Current enemies are immune to Acid and Oil).

Explosive - Base damage
Fire - Base damage + damage over time
Acid - Base damage + damage over time
Oil - Base damage + slow effect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/cd89fab0293f9a6a32f78d567d5482ab148efff3.png

Re-spawn
Introduced a new spirit effect that guides you to each orb. The orb pickup count has now been reduced to 2 while the spawn distance has been increased slightly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/278af5383f26c0e3dea120c4105401be9cd003b4.png

Traps
All traps are now clearly visible before being triggered. The trap trigger radius for the pillars and quick enemies has been increased to allow for more reaction time.

Dodging
Cool-down time has been reduced to 4 seconds and dodging now pushes away particular enemies that move to the player.

Loot
Added 3 new junk loot items with high value and rare drop chance. For now they are just items you can sell but they will eventually have a greater purpose. More items like these will be added in the future.

Fixes

Current "Possessed" Level 5 enemy visual design change.
Boss "Puzzle" input acceptance tolerance and trigger time increased.
Fixed bug with client player models not replicating on death.
Fixed bug with client player not dodging sometimes.
Improved grenade hit function.
Added some lighting to player car interior.
Added right-click function on inventory items for quick sell/transfer.
Increased reticle visibility across all levels and lighting scenarios.
Moved player camera back slightly.


Feel free to jump in, try the update, and let me know what you think! ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/90b54f487b439e189550e25f49d16357fe3fba50.png
